criteria_results.text: A signed development build runs on a physical iPhone and verifies pairing, isolation failures, chat/SSE/PTY, approvals, every Tool, revocation, and background recovery; committed evidence uses only a non-sensitive model label, never a device UDID.
criteria_results.notes: The credential-configured local development app reached the Google account flow, but its authorization-code exchange returned HTTP 400. A safe production probe and source-contract comparison confirmed that the installed PR app sends the hardened server-pinned request while the deployed production API still requires the older caller-supplied redirect field. The full physical gate already requires an isolated branch-built API and private gateway, so this failure does not contradict a completed device or release claim.

process_issues.description: The local signed app was pointed at the deployed production API for the first account-flow tap even though the documented #1199 matrix requires the matching isolated branch backend.
process_issues.detected_by: Physical HTTP 400 plus a secret-free production request-shape probe and comparison with the PR app and API contracts.

failure_output: Physical iPhone: sign-in request failed with status 400.
suggested_follow_up: Keep the hardened request contract and draft PR intact. Configure the matching Google mobile client and redirect only in an isolated branch-built API, expose the test endpoints privately without exposing the engine, rebuild the development app against that private test origin, and repeat sign-in before the remaining #1199 matrix. Existing #1199 already owns this environment requirement; do not create a duplicate issue.
